# HUELINE Saturation SS27

> A fictional hand-dyed womenswear label, built as a front-end portfolio project by codelady-ship. One page holds a lookbook, a 3D wardrobe ring, a colour story and a filterable shop of 24 pieces; product pages, a bag, saved pieces and a demo checkout complete the flow. Nothing is for sale: no payment is taken and no orders ship.

Built with React, React Router, GSAP (ScrollTrigger, Flip), Lenis and Zustand, with an optional Express + MongoDB API. Without the API the site runs in demo mode on the bundled catalogue and stores the bag and saved pieces in the browser.

## Key pages

- [Home: lookbook, wardrobe, colour story and shop](https://codelady-ship.github.io/Ecommerse-app/)
- [Shop section](https://codelady-ship.github.io/Ecommerse-app/#shop)
- [Example product page](https://codelady-ship.github.io/Ecommerse-app/product?code=HL-T-01)
- [Demo checkout](https://codelady-ship.github.io/Ecommerse-app/checkout)
- [Source code](https://github.com/codelady-ship/Ecommerse-app)
